reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000679 (the melody read from 000679a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 16); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Hans G. Nageli's dates (1773–1836) are from our page for the tune DENNIS (content/hymns/tunes/dennis.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1836. Lowell Mason's dates (1792–1872) are from our page for the tune BETHANY (content/hymns/tunes/bethany.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1863. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000679a.nwc). The tune ends on G, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
